Chapter 6 - Types, Constants, and Global Functions / Types and Constants
Notebook

Notebook Kinds

The following constants represent the different types of entries in a Cyberdog notebook. These constants are used in the implementation of the Cyberdog notebook.
kNotebookKindTagCategory
The notebook entry is a category.
kNotebookKindTagCyberItem
The notebook entry is a Cyberdog item.
